data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Dzimaar means ‘the one who gathers’ or ‘the harvester’. This name is derived from the Arabic root ‘dzm’ meaning ‘to gather’. It is a powerful name for a boy, symbolizing the idea of collecting, accumulating, and bringing abundance into one's life. In the Islamic context, it can also be seen as a reference to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who gathered and brought the teachings of Islam to the world.
